scope: C# architecture, pragmatic DRY/SOLID, contracts, runtime ownership and affected callers; excludes style preferences.
inputs: Captured crew selection and affected references
Exact-source hosted CI and sanitized evidence
checks: Apply DRY and SOLID to observed business rules, responsibilities and caller contracts without speculative abstractions.
Trace changed public contracts through callers, implementations and serialization boundaries.
Check async ownership, cancellation, DI lifetimes, disposal, concurrency and nullability behavior.
Inspect failure consistency, data access costs, persistence and authorization invariants against trusted project guidance.
Require concrete consequences and proportionate corrections; exclude style preferences and unrelated design debt.
evidenceRules: Cite observed owning code and affected callers.
Report missing evidence as blocked, not a pass.
Do not infer runtime behavior from source-only review.
